question: MS-118: S1 single embeddings cannot update an S2 cache (0%). Is that a translation gap (fixable by a learned S1->S2 projector with a frozen target, JEPA-style) or a physical limit (radar lacks the optical signal the S2 decoder needs)?
projector: 1x1 conv MLP 768->1024->768, trained on TRAIN-split pairs: S1 single embedding (nearest date) -> S2 single embedding (frozen target), MSE + cosine, 8 epochs; report cos(P(s1),s2) vs raw cos(s1,s2)

arms.s1proj_frozen: translation test: the S2-trained GRU from MS-116 (frozen, same seed) fed with P(S1)
arms.s1proj: end-to-end: GRU trained on P(S1) inputs (projector fixed after its own fit)

folds: hiroshima, chimanimani (folds with S1 files for their tiles); thrissur/newzealand excluded (S1 files missing for many tiles, MS-118)

rule.translation_gap: s1proj recovery >= 40% in both folds -> radar can partially carry the optical cache once aligned (scoped claim)
rule.physical_limit: s1proj < 20% in both folds -> boundary condition: radar acquisitions cannot sustain an optical cache on this task
